reuse.why: Five actions get the flag through the existing getMonthActionCategories selector, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own inline exclusion check instead of being routed through it.

duplication.why: The new 'include hidden' rule is written twice: as a SQL predicate in getMonthActionCategories and as a boolean guard in copyPreviousMonth's inline filter, plus the same flag plumbing repeated in six signatures.

placement.why: The rule sits in the shared selector in budget/actions.ts where the exclusions live, though the copyPreviousMonth copy keeps part of it at the call site.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their selector, tests and a release note are changed.

maintainability.why: Workable, but the hidden-category rule now has two definitions that must be kept in sync and the flag is threaded by hand through every action.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts applies the hidden/hidden-group rule (now conditioned on includeHiddenCategories) inline instead of using getMonthActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden rule appears as `(? = 1 OR (c.hidden = 0 AND g.hidden = 0))` in getMonthActionCategories SQL and reshaped as `!includeHiddenCategories && (hidden === 1 || group_hidden === 1)` in copyPreviousMonth.
